Java.q: Which keyword makes a field belong to the class instead of each object?
Java.why: static members are shared by the whole class. Every object sees the same one.

Java.q: Which collection keeps insertion order and gives index access?
Java.why: ArrayList is backed by an array, so order is kept and get(i) is fast.

Java.q: Which access modifier gives a member the most restricted access?
Java.why: private restricts access to the declaring class and its nested or enclosing classes. It is more restrictive than public, protected or package access.
